prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic high-fashion studio portrait of three original approved adult women in a coordinated editorial trio composition.
prompt.main_subject: Three distinct original approved adult women: two kneeling symmetrically at left and right in glossy light-pink long-sleeve high-neck bodysuits with subtle white curved line patterns and white platform high-top sneakers, and one standing centrally with crossed arms in a glossy black version of the same high-neck outfit. Preserve distinct faces, natural skin texture, hair variation, and confident direct eye contact.
composition_elements: Two women kneel with knees together, hands flat on the floor in front, and bodies leaning forward; the central woman stands tall behind and between them with arms crossed.
Bright minimalist gray studio background and clean smooth floor.
Maintain the symmetrical three-person hierarchy, pink-black color contrast, glossy fabric reflections, and clear footwear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright clean large-source studio lighting with soft frontal fill, controlled specular reflections on glossy fabric, gentle floor shadows, and polished magazine-editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 group portrait, medium-format camera with 80mm lens at f/8, sharp faces and fabric seams, natural skin texture, restrained grain, clean neutral grading, no text or watermark.
